native_target_audit.optimizer_schedule_caveat: All rows shared one randomized batch order and cosine learning-rate schedule in the source calibration. Gradients and optimizer moments were nevertheless row-local because SparseAdam updated independent embedding rows and the native model had no shared trainable tensor.
native_target_audit.proof: The only learned tensor is sparse daily_raw_embedding.weight; the three SANOS tensors are fixed geometry buffers. Slicing dates cannot transmit 2025 quote values into a <=2024 row.

strong.validation_projection_definition: Least-squares projection of independent 2025 native raw rows onto the frozen train-only Strong affine decoder; this is an oracle state diagnostic, not a live market encoder.
